mode: contract — binds the capture-signal path for the UserVoiceNote rail (P4S-31D1-B/C); no ambient/mobile/desktop-app activation authorized
doctrine: Capture must be VISIBLE and failure must be LEGIBLE. A recording card shows a live client-computed RMS meter so the operator sees the mic is actually delivering samples; when a draft fails, the SPECIFIC cause is shown. A mic-silent, empty-blob, or decode failure must NEVER be reported as a bare 'No speech detected' — that mis-diagnosis is the exact bug this contract closes (a suspended capture AudioContext produced zero samples and the UI called it no-speech).

root_cause_closed.symptom: every voice note failed with 'No speech detected'
root_cause_closed.true_cause: the capture-side AudioContext was suspended, so ScriptProcessor.onaudioprocess never fired; zero PCM reached the server; the server's VAD correctly reported no speech; the UI collapsed all failures to 'No speech detected', hiding the real (silent-capture) cause
root_cause_closed.fix_location: capture AudioContext resume (fixed elsewhere, P4S-31D1-C capture fix)
root_cause_closed.ui_guarantee_here: the live RMS meter makes a silent capture immediately visible, and the failure taxonomy names the real cause instead of 'No speech detected'

ordered_signal_chain: non_zero_energy: client-computed capture RMS rises above the silence floor while the user speaks (proves the mic + AudioContext deliver samples)
valid_blob: MediaRecorder produces a non-empty audio blob on stop (EMPTY_AUDIO_BLOB if zero bytes)
server_decode: the server decodes the uploaded/streamed audio (DECODE_FAILED / UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_FORMAT otherwise)
vad_speech: server VAD finds speech in the decoded audio (VAD_NO_SPEECH otherwise, draft recoverable)
stt_transcript: STT returns a transcript (STT_FAILED otherwise, audio preserved for retry)
preserved_artifact: the recorded audio is preserved on EVERY failure path — never discarded except on explicit delete
transcript_under_card: the finalized transcript renders UNDERNEATH the voice bubble, not in the message input
pause_doesnt_send: a sentence-internal pause (< intra_utterance_pause_ms) never finalizes; a finalize is not a send
explicit_send: a draft becomes a chat message ONLY on the operator's explicit Send (auto_send=false, no exceptions)
chat_only_after_send: no chat message, IntentSpec, or loop entry exists for a draft whose status != 'sent'
delete_leaves_no_trace: delete discards the draft + audio artifact and revokes the blob URL; no chat trace, no loop entry

fields.clientRms: float 0..1 — RMS of the most recent capture buffer, computed client-side from the same PCM the WS ships. The VISIBLE proof of capture. Read at ~10Hz (METER_POLL_MS=100) into voiceMessageStore.captureRms.
fields.captureRmsPeak: float 0..1 — highest clientRms seen this session; a peak that stays ~0 during live recording is the silent-capture signature
fields.captureSilentMs: int — ms the session has run flat-at-0 past the grace window (MIC_SILENT_HINT_MS=2000); > 0 arms the 'mic appears silent' hint
fields.chunksSent: int — PCM16 buffers pushed to the server (0 during a silent/suspended capture)
fields.lastCaptureMsAgo: int | null — ms since the last processed buffer (capture liveness)

meter.law: the meter reads a store field the controller writes; it runs NO audio loop of its own and performs NO FFT — one getter read + one shallow store write per tick

error_codes.EMPTY_AUDIO_BLOB: the uploaded/streamed audio had zero bytes — capture produced nothing
error_codes.SILENT_AUDIO: audio present but below the energy floor — mic delivered near-silence
error_codes.UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_FORMAT: the audio container/codec is not decodable on the server (e.g. an iOS-only codec)
error_codes.DECODE_FAILED: the audio bytes could not be decoded (corrupt/truncated container)
error_codes.VAD_NO_SPEECH: audio decoded but VAD found no speech segment
error_codes.STT_FAILED: decode + VAD passed but the STT engine returned no transcript

error_taxonomy.law: every code maps to a DISTINCT operator-facing string; none collapses to 'No speech detected'. Mic-silent (SILENT_AUDIO), empty-blob (EMPTY_AUDIO_BLOB), and decode failures (DECODE_FAILED / UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_FORMAT) are visibly different from a genuine no-speech (VAD_NO_SPEECH / NO_SPEECH).

codes.EMPTY_AUDIO_BLOB: No audio captured — mic sent no bytes
codes.SILENT_AUDIO: Mic appears silent — no audio energy detected
codes.UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_FORMAT: Unsupported audio format for this browser
codes.VAD_NO_SPEECH: No speech found in the recording
codes.NO_SPEECH: No speech detected before the pause
codes.RETRY_DECODE_FAILED: Stored audio could not be decoded for retry
codes.RETRY_TIMEOUT: Retry timed out — server did not respond
codes.CHAT_SEND_FAILED: Could not deliver to chat — send again

platform_matrix.note: This matrix classifies capture status PER PLATFORM for THIS bug. A mobile-platform capture failure must NOT reject the desktop_chrome verdict — each row stands alone.

desktop_chrome.root_cause: suspended capture AudioContext — onaudioprocess never fired, zero PCM shipped, server VAD correctly saw no speech, UI mislabeled it 'No speech detected'
desktop_chrome.resolution: capture AudioContext resume + this contract's live RMS meter (makes a silent capture visible) + precise failure taxonomy (names the real cause)
desktop_chrome.verdict: PASS — primary target; capture visible, failures legible

mobile_chrome.root_cause: n/a — Android Chrome supports the shipped webm/opus MediaRecorder path
mobile_chrome.verdict: PASS (path supported; end-to-end proof deferred to a mobile pass)

mobile_safari.root_cause: iOS Safari does not support any MIME in the shipped MediaRecorder candidate list (audio/webm, audio/ogg, audio/wav); iOS requires audio/mp4 (AAC), which is absent from _pickRecorderMime()
mobile_safari.resolution: add an audio/mp4 candidate to the recorder mime list AND a server-side AAC decode path — tracked, NOT fixed here
mobile_safari.verdict: DOCUMENTED FAILURE — does not reject desktop_chrome

desktop_safari.root_cause: not yet evaluated; macOS Safari MediaRecorder support differs from Chrome
desktop_safari.verdict: LATER — out of scope for this packet

invariants_reused_from_message_contract: no chat message may exist for a draft whose status is not 'sent'
audio preserved on STT failure — retry uses the stored artifact, never re-recording by force
send only when transcript_status in {final, edited} and status == ready
diagnostics carry timings and counts, never transcript text
delete discards draft + artifact; no chat trace
hard_constraints: the meter reads client-computed RMS, never server transcript content
no transcript (partial or final) is ever pasted into the message input
send is explicit-only; a pause/finalize is never a send
a silent-capture / empty-blob / decode failure is never reported as 'No speech detected'
mobile capture failure does not reject the desktop capture verdict
